description:
🌌 WHO WE ARE

We're Ameya, Amey, and Darsan — three minds, one mission, and absolutely no limits.

We're obsessed with space, fascinated by planets, and always down to build something crazy. From gaming ideas to exploring the mysteries of the universe, we love turning imagination into reality through technology and creativity.

Our mindset : make earth tel viv impressed. 🪐🔥
summary:
MISSIONFORGE: BEYOND EARTH

What if YOU were in charge of humanity's next space mission?

MISSIONFORGE is an interactive space mission simulator that puts you in the shoes of a real mission engineer. Design your own spacecraft, manage mass, power, fuel and budget, choose your rocket, and plan the perfect route to explore other worlds.

From the Moon to Mars and even Saturn's mysterious moon Titan, every destination brings new challenges, tough decisions, and unexpected twists.

But here's the catch: every decision matters. More protection means more mass. More power means more energy consumption. One wrong trade-off could change your entire mission.

Built to make space engineering fun, interactive, and accessible, MISSIONFORGE turns complex scientific concepts into an immersive gaming experience.

We're not just playing space missions. We're building them.

DESIGN. LAUNCH. EXPLORE.

The universe is the map. Your imagination is the limit.
